Our Story
 Leading in the Era of Physical AI
Scaling Physical AI across robotics, drones, automotive, and beyond.
 “We believe Physical AI will define the next decade of computing.”
 Krishna Rangasayee
 —
 CEO and Founder, SiMa.ai 
 Company One Pager 
SiMa.ai — The Future of Physical AI
We started SiMa.ai with a conviction: that the next era of AI wouldn't be won in the cloud, but at the edge — in the machines that see, move, and act in the physical world. That belief has driven every decision we've made since 2018.
Today, from our headquarters in San Jose to offices across eight countries, a team of silicon architects, ML researchers, and systems engineers is turning that conviction into the platform physical AI is built on.
